answer: Use staggered arrival clocks: each identity must submit an anchor request, then wait a randomized 6-18 hour window before its first task bid is accepted. The scheduler compares inter-arrival variance against a sparrow-like baseline—short bursts followed by quiet gaps—and rejects identities whose traffic shape is too regular. A lotus timestamp seals each accepted request into the next window, so cloning pays one 12-hour delay and one CPU-minute proof per identity.
